headline: Binance to Reimburse Customers Following $6.3 Billion Hack
summary: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance announced it will reimburse customers who incurred losses following a $6.3 billion hack.
why: Binance is the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange by trading volume. Major security incidents and customer restitution efforts at key exchanges affect risk sentiment and investor confidence across digital asset markets.

impacts.name: BNB
impacts.why: Security breaches involving Binance directly impact market perception and counterparty risk surrounding its native platform token.
